items.title: Debug a search reset
items.content: Debug a search box in a small recipe app. Typing a query filters recipes correctly, but clearing the query leaves the results empty. Use the selected context to propose the smallest code change and a regression test. Call out anything that needs checking in the source.
items.purpose: Start a coding draft and try a local compilation with selected sources.
items.outputCriteria: A focused investigation, a proposed fix, and a regression test.
items.provenance: Fictional scenario from the PCR Playground sample pack.

items.title: Recipe search behavior
items.content: The recipe list holds six entries in memory. A blank query should show all six recipes in their original order. A nonblank query matches recipe titles without regard to case. The search box has no server dependency.
items.purpose: Add the expected behavior as a requirement and inspect its source reference.
items.outputCriteria: The proposed fix restores the full list when the query is cleared.
items.provenance: Fictional context from the PCR Playground sample pack.

items.title: Search fix checklist
items.content: Exercise three steps in one regression test: start with a blank query, enter a query that matches one title, then clear it. Check result count and order after clearing. Separate observations from proposed causes.
items.purpose: Add review criteria and toggle their inclusion to compare two compilations.
items.outputCriteria: The regression covers the blank, filtered, and cleared states.
items.provenance: Fictional checklist from the PCR Playground sample pack.
